title: Raise auxiliary project TargetFramework to match Core's new framework (NU1201)
problemSignature: NU1201: Project NGO.Core.* is not compatible with net<old>. It supports net<new>.

requiredRepoCharacteristics: auxiliary NGO.Migration.* or NGO.DataMigration projects reference Core

exclusions: Do not raise TargetFramework on projects that must remain on an older framework for deployment reasons without approval.
rootCauseHypothesis: A Core major bump raises the target framework; downstream projects still pinned to the old framework fail NuGet resolution.
proposedActions: Identify projects failing NU1201 against a Core package.
Set their <TargetFramework> to the framework the target Core version supports (see knowledge/canonical/versions/{target}.json.targetFramework).
